channel.description: Latest articles from The Patriot Post (patriotpost.us)

item.title: No Time?
item.description: Our "no time" excuses with God don't really fly. We all have 24-hour days. How we prioritize that time is what gives the direction to our life.

item.title: America 250: The Rights of Englishmen
item.description: The leaders in the English colonies had not forgotten the significance of the Magna Carta.

item.title: Profiles of Valor: Chaplain CAPT Joseph O'Callahan (USN)
item.description: "Serving with courage, fortitude, and deep spiritual strength, [he] inspired the gallant officers and men of the Franklin to fight heroically and with profound faith in the face of almost certain death."

item.title: CAP's Foolish Plan to Cap Grocery Prices
item.description: Left-wingers caused inflation, and now that it's nearly back down to normal, they have a "solution" to fix it.

item.title: Homan 'Saved the Day'
item.description: Border Czar Tom Homan has done outstanding work to calm the situation in Minneapolis and refocus ICE on doing the hard job of deportation.

item.title: Democrats, Your Name Is Mud
item.description: Whether people vote Democrat or Republican, the American public holds an increasingly negative view of the donkey party.

item.title: Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor's Unsatisfactory Arrest
item.description: The brother of King Charles III was apprehended for allegedly giving away trade secrets to Jeffrey Epstein. Is this a hopeful sign, or evidence of a scapegoat?

item.title: Trump Touts Affordability in GA
item.description: Our multitasking president continued his nationwide economic tour yesterday, stopping by the Peach State to endorse an outstanding congressional candidate.

item.title: Friday Executive News Summary
item.description: Inaugural Board of Peace meeting, Virginia gerrymandering referendum halted, UAW gets another win, East Wing designs gets the green light, and more.

item.title: Supreme Court Strikes Down Trump's Tariffs
item.description: In dissent, Justice Brett Kavanaugh wrote, "The tariffs at issue here may or may not be wise policy. But as a matter of text, history, and precedent, they are clearly lawful."
